column3: CONCEPT “paper chaos into calm”. In the upper part of the scene, a dramatic swirl of real paper letters, envelopes, bills and forms (an insurance renewal letter, a water bill, a passport form, a school permission slip) fly through the air in a curved stream and flow INTO the phone screen, glowing marigold where they enter. The phone (large, lower centre, tilted 7 degrees) shows the Due Meld HOME screen in light theme recreated from the attached screenshot: “Wednesday, October 28”, huge bold plum “2 overdue, 3 due this week.”, “$2,572.39 due in the next 30 days”, day chips W 28, T 29, F 30, S 31, S 1, M 2. Coming OUT of the phone on the right, three neat glossy white deadline cards float in a tidy stack, each with a date tile: “OCT 29 · Free trial ends · Tomorrow · $15.99”, “NOV 11 · Water bill · In 14 days · $86.20”, “NOV 18 · Passport renewal · In 21 days”. Messy on the left, calm and organised on the right.

CONCEPT “everything around one phone”. A large phone in the centre (tilted 6 degrees) shows the Due Meld HOME screen in light theme recreated from the attached screenshot: “Wednesday, October 28”, huge bold plum “2 overdue, 3 due this week.”, “$2,572.39 due in the next 30 days”, a plum card “Next up · School field trip form · Due today · $25.00”. Around the phone, FOUR glossy floating feature cards at different depths, each connected to the phone by a thin glowing marigold line: top left a camera scan card showing a paper letter inside marigold scan corners with the label “Snap a letter”; top right an AI quote card with a sparkle icon “Found in the letter: Payment due by November 11”; lower left an iOS notification “DUE MELD · Car insurance renews in 7 days” with small chips “30 days”, “7 days”, “1 day”; lower right a household card with two round avatars A and S and the label “Shared with your household”. Elegant, balanced, premium.

CONCEPT “one snap, from letter to reminder”. A cinematic close-up: a real paper renewal letter lies on a warm wooden kitchen table at night in soft lamplight; a large modern iPhone hovers above it at an angle, its camera view showing the letter inside glowing marigold scan corners, with the due date line on the paper lit up in marigold light and a beam of light connecting it to the phone. On the phone screen, over the camera view, a white result card slides up: sparkle icon “We found 1 deadline”, big “November 4, 2026”, “Car insurance renewal”, a marigold button “Save item”. Floating above the phone at the top right, a glossy iOS notification: “DUE MELD · 9:00 AM”, bold “Car insurance renews in 7 days”, “Reminders 30, 7 and 1 days before”. Rich plum and marigold colour grade.
